leads.name: Acacia patrimonial en Magdalena del Mar, registro 1
leads.species: Acacia (genus only; Peruvian coverage suggests Acacia macracantha but not confirmed on a fetched page)
leads.reason: Part of Magdalena del Mar's 8-tree heritage register (2nd-most of any Lima district per infobae Jan 2026), declared by a municipal ordinance this pass could not retrieve in full (munimagdalena.gob.pe's own article on the program did not return readable body text; the 2020 ordinance number was not found via search). A WebSearch AI summary mentioned Acacia macracantha at 'Plaza Tupac Amaru' but per the search-summary-is-a-lead-never-a-source rule this was never confirmed against a fetched page, so it is recorded here as an unverified pointer only, not used as fact. No exact address or age found on any page actually fetched.
